narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Four and eight tenths is four plus eight, so twelve tenths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But four whole units are forty tenths, and that is far more than twelve.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A unit is not one tenth. A unit is ten tenths.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble shows 4 + 8 = 12 tenths; four unit bars each split into ten tenths appear; the slip is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Multiply the units by ten, and then add the tenths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. A seed pod is five units and two tenths. Write it in two ways.
removed_beats.on_screen: the words multiply the units by ten, then add the tenths appear; a seed pod of 5 units and 2 tenths with two empty boxes
